g.text: ❯ show the 5h and weekly windows while I work
● A dock along the bottom of every tab, and bars under
each agent. ⚙ picks what they show.
↑↓ ←→ move · space toggles · click · q closes
the usage dock sits along the bottom of every tab
⚙ opens the settings — the dock follows at once
…and so do the bars under each agent
